dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The visible lateral margins appear smooth and symmetrical with no localized bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median tone with a subtle blue-violet shift likely due to water depth.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Faint, low-density, and diffuse dark-grey patches visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between the darker posterior pigmented areas and the lighter anterior baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, white linear scratches (rake marks) on the mid-dorsal surface and several small white punctate marks on the posterior right flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of superficial, healed linear rake marks concentrated across the mid-dorsal plane.
